skills.name: Portfolio Site Builder
skills.blurb: Get a real portfolio website online — no tech skills needed.
skills.longDescription: A guided, plain-language path for photographers with no technical background to get a portfolio website online. It tells you what to expect to pay each month (in your currency), helps register a web address, curates and sequences your strongest work, and writes your bio and artist statement in your voice. Then it publishes the way that fits you: a point-and-click visual builder (Squarespace/Wix/Pixieset), a free site you fully own via drag-and-drop, or a code deploy to Vercel/Cloudflare Pages. Ships a minimal, trilingual (English/日本語/简体中文) template and ends with a live link plus a simple way to add photos later.
